run_panoptic_evaluation_cli: run panoptic segmentation evaluation from command line with gt and pred JSON and directory arguments
create_COCOPanopticEvaluator: create a COCOPanopticEvaluator instance for a named dataset with an optional output directory
process_panoptic_predictions: process model inputs and outputs to convert panoptic segmentation predictions into evaluation-ready format
evaluate_panoptic_quality: evaluate panoptic quality metrics including PQ, SQ, and RQ for things and stuff categories
convert_category_id: convert contiguous category IDs to dataset IDs for thing and stuff segments in panoptic predictions
